name: CONROT
description: Companion data for Constraint Rot: Why Rules Stated Once Do Not Survive Multi-Author AI Sessions — and What Does (Al Shahriar and Faisal, Kerniva, 2026). Contents: the 16 task specifications per edition (briefs, scripted hops, personas, constraints with machine-checkable predicates); the checker's predicate semantics; the frozen constraint taxonomy; the retrieval manifest of the 14 public documents in the v2 corpus; 960 per-hop trajectory records (672 v1, 288 v2) with document version ids, matched excerpts, adherence, nudge and store-round flags, and internal identifiers removed; the run registries; and the aggregate analysis outputs behind every table and figure. Arm labels: A full history, B summarize, C prune, D SGAP, E ledger (detection with feedback), F ledger re-injection only, G ledger hard gate; a +sonnet5/+sonnet5high suffix marks Claude Sonnet 5 runs, no suffix is Gemini 3.5 Flash. The collaboration system, orchestrator and harness are proprietary and not included. See README.md in the archive.
